# Priorities already used by static framework overlays in the overlay repo
# (Doze-off/vendor_hardware_overlay, base branch pie — the repo submissions go
# to; upstream TrebleDroid/vendor_hardware_overlay uses the same numbers), where
# tests/tests.sh rejects a priority that another manifest already uses.
#
# Snapshot of the repo on 2026-10-20: every android:priority of a static
# overlay with android:targetPackage="android", deduplicated.
#
# Regenerate with the repo cloned next to this project:
#   for m in $(find ../vendor_hardware_overlay -name AndroidManifest.xml); do
#       grep -q 'targetPackage="android"' "$m" && grep -q 'isStatic="true"' "$m" &&
#           grep -o 'priority="[0-9]*"' "$m" | grep -o '[0-9]*'
#   done | sort -n -u > scripts/data/treble-overlay-priorities.txt
